name: Scheherazade
source:
A Macedonian sorcerer.

She makes a living by entering the dreams of others to heal their fatigue and worries. Because she spends most of her time in her own or someone else's dreams, she is always sleepwalking in the real world.

According to her, it seems that she is able to communicate even while sleepwalking.
